comments.author: @LifewaysTravel
comments.text: Mahé looks like a dream vacation spot, but there's so much more to life here than beautiful beaches and luxury resorts! 🌴🇸🇨 What surprised you most about everyday life in Seychelles? Could you imagine living on this island? I'd love to hear your thoughts! Thanks for watching and being part of our journey! ❤

comments.author: @lifeonearth68
comments.text: Imagine working all day at a beautiful beach resort while everyone around you is on vacation 😂 Anyone from Seychelles know what hotel life is actually like for the locals?

comments.author: @travellives
comments.text: Honestly, turning a traditional resistance dance like Moutya into hotel entertainment for resort guests always feels a bit uncomfortable once you know its actual history

comments.author: @lornaduncan5273
comments.text: Watching from Canada. The grilled fish looked scrumptious and I will be putting Seychelles on my bucket list. TFS.🥂🍾

replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: It’s wonderful to hear that Mahé has made it onto your bucket list, and I hope you get to try that fresh grilled fish in person one day! 🐟🇸🇨

replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: Sending so much love to beautiful Seychelles! 🇸🇨❤ It’s a true honor to have someone local watching our documentary on Mahé. 🙏

comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: I never really pictured traffic and early morning commutes as part of life in Seychelles. For people traveling into Victoria every day, are public buses reliable enough to get to work and school on time? And with the island's mountainous roads, does commuting become especially difficult during heavy rain?

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Those granite boulders, turquoise waters, and lush green mountains are simply incredible. I especially love seeing how Creole culture gives the Seychelles its own identity. It's not just a beautiful island destination; it's a place with a fascinating story and way of life.
